docs/guide.md:7:This project uses software engineering to manage the automated generation, optimization, and maintenance of a complete programming project by AI. It builds large-model development orchestration around the Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, Antigravity CLI (`agy`), and LLM APIs, with Gemini retained only as a deprecated legacy compatibility host, plugging the right large model into the right scenario and making the best decisions across four dimensions: development needs, cost, efficiency, and production quality. It forms a closed development loop from a stakeholder raising a requirement, to the requirement landing as documentation, to task breakdown, and finally to delivery. The end goal is a system that can be maintained over the long term and that self-tunes and self-upgrades automatically.

docs/guide.md:7:This project uses software engineering to manage the automated generation, optimization, and maintenance of a complete programming project by AI. It builds large-model development orchestration around the Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, Antigravity CLI (`agy`), and LLM APIs, with Gemini retained only as a deprecated legacy compatibility host, plugging the right large model into the right scenario and making the best decisions across four dimensions: development needs, cost, efficiency, and production quality. It forms a closed development loop from a stakeholder raising a requirement, to the requirement landing as documentation, to task breakdown, and finally to delivery. The end goal is a system that can be maintained over the long term and that self-tunes and self-upgrades automatically.

    Resolves: B-137a:F-109
    
    lattice-review-concept filed F-109 (critical) refuting the justification I
    wrote when dismissing F-106. It is right and I was wrong. Verified every claim
    myself before correcting:
    
    My F-106 note said agyPrintTimeout was "dead on the managed path but live on
    the non-managed host_run path (host-run.ts:1637), exercised by
    host-run-usage-smoke". All three parts are false:
    
    1. materializeLaunch throws for ANY caller with host === 'agy'
       (host-run.ts:1630), managed or not, BEFORE the materializeLauncherArgv call
       at 1636 that would substitute the value. There is no "non-managed path"
       that reaches it.
    2. `--print-timeout` appears only in the agy launcher spec
       (host-execution-readiness.ts:98-103). The codex/claude callers that DO reach
       the substitution have no such flag, so durationFlagIndex is never >= 0.
    3. The smoke I cited as proof of liveness ("CHK-001 agy safety",
       host-run-usage-smoke.ts:927-937) asserts sink.calls === 0 and
       sink.lastPlan === null. It proves the runner is NEVER invoked -- the exact
       opposite of what I claimed it proved.
    
    So the field is unreachable on every path, not just the managed one. The
    comment now says that plainly, explains why it is retained anyway (it is the
    carrier that goes live the day agy gains a stdin or protected prompt-file
    transport, when the refusal lifts and every hop becomes live at once), and
    records that the previously-cited smoke proves refusal rather than liveness.
    
    This was a critical finding, so it is fixed rather than deferred despite the
    freeze-HEAD policy for this round; low/medium findings remain deferred.
    
    No behaviour change -- comment only. Verified: build clean, validate --lint
    pass (tsc 3 tsconfigs), host-run-usage-smoke exit 0 (all 88 checks).

Fail-closed caps run BEFORE spawn — the per-dispatch hard-budget cap (`LATTICE_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS`) and a host-run concurrency cap (`LATTICE_HOST_RUN_MAX_CONCURRENT`, default 4; stale slots reclaimed via `LATTICE_HOST_RUN_SLOT_STALE_MS`, default 6h; no queuing) — and each refusal is recorded as a blocked ledger row. The same seam now also covers the autopilot repair step, the host-readiness probes, and the cross-host-review codex leaf so those runs are no longer invisible in the ledger. Added `lattice usage_sweep`, a strictly read-only retro-attribution sweep over `~/.codex/sessions` rollouts and `~/.claude/projects` transcripts that emits a NON-AUTHORITATIVE token-attribution estimate only (no ledger backfill, no gate evidence). Usage rows stay `gateEvidence=false` diagnostics and never gate the workflow. New docs page `docs/host-run-usage.md`; new smokes `host-run-usage-smoke` + `usage-sweep-smoke` wired as `test:host-run-usage` / `test:usage-sweep`.
